scope: Two elementary power-rule antiderivatives; one unit-magnitude nonconstant coefficient, one signed constant; no logarithms, definite integrals, substitution, products or integration conditions. Explicit positive radical domain.
families: P/B integer exponents 2..6; R negative half-integer exponents -3/2 and -7/2. Same workload as moderate q-71167, q-71169 and q-133291.
unsupported_source_families: Unlabelled q-2159 and q-29828 are full-bank replay-only; fieldless q-71173 and hard q-113781 mathematical replay-only. No easy-labelled source. R5 is outside this conservative same-method family; no claim of covering all rational powers.
bank_constraint_assessment: Three constants and two power coefficients are competing same-method answers; both coefficient sides, every eligible omission and each constant rank remain eligible. Same-sign bounded constants remove a cue without fixing the true constant rank.
